label: Gradient-as-default signal
why: A gradient is not wrong; it needs a brand or information purpose rather than acting as instant 'premium' decoration.
action: Keep only if it supports hierarchy, identity or information.

label: Rounded-card saturation signal
why: Large rounded containers are a common default when agents need a section but have not solved hierarchy.
action: Remove container chrome unless grouping genuinely needs a boundary.

label: Generic reveal animation signal
why: Repeated entrance motion can become decoration rather than explanation.
action: Keep movement only when it clarifies sequence, state, causality or focus.
